Select: canonical_smiles, compound_name, met_conversion, pathway_key. Source: metabolism, compound_records, compound_structures. Join: metabolism.substrate_record_id = compound_records.record_id AND compound_records.molregno = compound_structures.molregno. Filter: None. Sort: canonical_smiles ASC, compound_name ASC, met_conversion ASC, pathway_key ASC. Limit: 200.
